rules.R1_spaces:
Q4S = QdS (+) Q(4-d)S; g4 = ghat + gtilde; tr g4 = 4, tr ghat = d, tr gtilde = 4-d; ghat.gha
  +> t = ghat, gtilde.gtilde = gtilde, ghat.gtilde = 0, g4.X = X
rules.R2_momenta:
loop momentum l in QdS; external momenta p in QdS (p.gtilde = 0, stated choice); field/vert
  +> ex/polarisation indices in Q4S
rules.R3_lifting:
exported lower components l_r = l.e_(r) = l.ehat_(r), p_r = p.e_(r), e_(r) the eta-orthonor
  +> mal basis of Q4S; vertex tensors lifted with eta -> g4
rules.R4_reduction:
Gram/PV projection on symmetric ghat/p tensors with symbolic d; ghat_rs = eta_rs - Gt_rs,
  +>  eta^{rs} Gt_rs = 4-d, Gt_rs p^s = 0
rules.R5_order:
all contractions (incl. external 4D projection) BEFORE the Laurent expansion; d kept symbolic
  +>  through MS-bar subtraction and finite-part extraction; (d-4) x pole retained
rules.R6_evanescent:
evanescent remainders arise in general and are retained (Gt structures; (4-d) x pole fin
  +> ite terms); the p14 'none arise' statement is withdrawn

literature_background_only:
A. Signer, D. Stockinger, Nucl. Phys. B808 (2
  +> 009) 88, arXiv:0807.4424
